svg.title: Shadow acne, as it actually appears
svg.desc: A mock of the renderer's output with no depth bias: a torus casting a correct shadow onto a ground plane that is itself covered in a dense moire of dark curved fringes, bunching toward the horizon.
svg.text: What the first correct implementation puts on screen
36,786 pixels of a 480x270 frame, and not one line of code misbehaved.
The fringes bunch toward the horizon because they are level sets of a projective
coordinate. An SVG mock, drawn from that formula; the real frame is a PPM.
